messages:
ana: Postmortem follow-up for Corsair Dedicated isolation. Root causes: intermittent VPC peering flaps + customer on-prem NAT ephemeral exhaustion. Need owners for short mitigations, runbook, alerts, and a joint test. Postmortem doc + pcaps: https://intra.redwood/pm/corsair-isolation

kevin: I'll own the edge mitigation: implement per-tenant reconnect cooldown + feature-flag. Plan: 60s cooldown after 5 failed attempts. ETA: 2026-03-28. Will add metric cooldown_trigger_count.

sylvia: I'll take the on-prem runbook: NAT table checks, ephemeral port ranges, tcpdump steps, and vendor notes (Cisco/Arista). ETA: 2026-03-30. Will include exact commands and expected ranges.

ben: Eng-infra / alerts: propose alert thresholds and dashboard snippet. Suggest BGP flaps >3/10m OR peer_reauths >90/min -> page. I'll create ALERT-9320.

ops-bot: ALERT-9320 created: "Corsair: BGP flap / peer_reauths escalation" -> https://tracker.redwood/ALERT-9320

kevin: Short-term config: feature_flag.edge_cooldown default off for Dedicated; will expose console toggle and docs. PR by 2026-03-26.

sylvia: Runbook snippet to include:
```
# ephemeral ports usage
ss -s | grep ephemeral
# established connection count
netstat -an | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
# pcap
tcpdump -w /tmp/corsair.pcap host <peer-ip> and port <peer-port>
```
Will attach expected thresholds and escalation steps.

ana: Consolidated actions:
- A1: Edge per-tenant cooldown (short-term) - owner: kevin - due: 2026-03-26 - note: feature-flag + metrics
- A2: On-prem preflight & tcpdump runbook - owner: sylvia - due: 2026-03-30
- A3: Ops alerts & dashboard - owner: ben (eng-infra) - alert: ALERT-9320
- A4: Joint customer test window coordination - owner: ana - target week of 2026-03-30

ben: I'll also add a Grafana panel template for peer_reauths and BGP flap rate and include it in sylvia's runbook. ETA 2026-03-25.

kevin: I'll include unit/integration tests and a small chaos test to simulate repeated peer resets. PR link will go here when ready.

sylvia: Will include vendor-specific kernel tunings and a checklist for NAT table sizing.

ana: Let's reconvene Fri 03/27 09:00 PT for status. Drop PRs, ticket IDs, or test results here. Thanks everyone.
